sloka: इदमाभरणं सौम्य तारणार्थं द्विजोत्तम ।प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। ७.७८.२४ ॥
transliteration: idamābharaṇaṁ saumya tāraṇārthaṁ dvijottama ।pratigṛhṇīṣva bhadraṁ te prasādaṁ kartumarhasi ।। 7.78.24 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, O best of brahmins, please accept this ornament for my deliverance; may good fortune be yours, and you ought to grant this favor.
